title: Website terms
description: Working terms governing use of the Impact Sol. information website and its enquiry routes.
body: These working draft terms apply to the public Impact Sol. information website and its enquiry forms. Impact Sol. is a Bangladesh-based business operating under a DNCC trade licence. The website provides general information, invites enquiries and describes plans that may change. It does not itself make an offer, create a contract, partnership, agency, funding commitment, employment relationship or product-access right. Chokro is owned by Impact Sol.; its Google Play and Apple App Store launch is planned for 28 September 2026 but remains subject to store review and final release checks. Website content is not legal, financial, investment, environmental-certification or other professional advice. These terms preserve rights and liabilities that cannot lawfully be excluded and are intended to be governed by the laws of Bangladesh. Qualified legal review remains required before this working version is marked approved.
